# Audit implementation completeness and correctness
run a critical verification if the design is really 100% following the task or discuessed design or given references. Make sure, the ai agent did not leave out or simplified anything. we need a 100% match.
If verification is not passed:
Check if there is a real blocker why the design did not pass. In that case explain the issues in the chat and ask the user to resolve it.
If there is no valid blocker, restart the task with a prompt injected, explaining why validation failed and asked to fix it.
